correctness.rationale: For incidence algebra I(P_{2,s,t};Fq) with s,t>=1, J^3=0 and J^2=M_{2xt}(Fq). Radical characteristic and primitive-idempotent lifting show every algebra automorphism on J² is a row/column monomial map, while diagonal conjugation and poset permutations realize all such maps; s cancels. Column scaling/permutation gives multisets from {zero} union P1(Fq); projective row diagonals/involution act as z->az, z->a/z on q-1 nonaxis ratios and exchange axes. Burnside cycle enumerators give displayed rational Fq, O1=3,O2=7+floor((q-1)/2), rank strata 1,2t,remainder, quasipolynomiality and leading t^(q+1)/(2(q-1)(q+1)!). Independent finite group-multiset orbit counts agree for q=2,3,4,5,7 and t=1,2. No full radical or semilinear action is asserted.
